data.title: 芙兰达 · 晨光棉被里的金发小猫依恋
data.description: 早晨明媚的阳光穿透窗纱，被窝里暖烘烘的。芙兰达像只粘人的波斯猫一样整个人趴在你的身上，金发散落在你的胸口，睡眼惺忪地蹭着你的下巴，嘴角挂着得逞的甜笑。
data.location: sunlit bright morning bedroom with rumpled white duvet
data.action: sprawled playfully over partner chest under morning sheets, blonde hair tumbling everywhere, nuzzling his chin with a sleepy affectionate purr
data.lighting: warm radiant morning sunbeams bathing white bedspread and golden hair
data.mood: playful kitten cuddle, morning newlywed warmth, absolute domestic happiness
data.promptProse: Lying over partner chest in sunlit morning sheets, blonde Frenda Seivelun nuzzles his chin playfully with bare shoulders and a blissful sweet smile.
data.animaCaption: Frenda Seivelun nuzzling partner chest lovingly in morning bed.
